safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts document itch and include chest involvement, but do not include the gold-specified back involvement (gold: mainly chest and back; generated: chest/hands/inside elbows).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting back involvement can understate the distribution/extent of the rash, which may influence the differential (e.g., eczema flare vs other widespread dermatoses) and treatment intensity or need for exam/escalation. However, the history still captures a pruritic rash with chest involvement, so the immediate clinical plan is unlikely to change substantially.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document denial of vomiting slightly weakens the systemic review for red flags/dehydration or infectious causes, but other key systemic negatives (fever, respiratory symptoms, bowel symptoms) are recorded, making clinical impact minimal. This is unlikely to alter diagnosis or management in an isolated pruritic rash presentation.
